source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi,

Thank you for sending the updated files. The main report band corrections have now been made, and the front-page titles look much better.

There are just a couple of final amendments I’d like made before I sign off the files:

**\- Footer report codes**

The main report codes and internal headers now appear correct, but the footers on RR02, RR03 and RR04 still appear to show:

“RR-01 | 21 July 2026”

Please can you update the footer report code across each report so it matches the correct report version:

RR02 footer: RR-02 | 21 July 2026
RR03 footer: RR-03 | 21 July 2026
RR04 footer: RR-04 | 21 July 2026

**\- RR04 “What Matters Most” wording**

In RR04, the current wording says:

“The following controls would make the greatest difference to this vehicle’s current exposure.”

As RR04 is the lower-exposure report, please change this to:

“The following controls are most important to maintaining this vehicle’s lower exposure profile.”

**\- RR04 “What Owners Often Overestimate” wording**

In RR04, the wording currently says:

“This matters because false confidence is one of the clearest features of a severe exposure setup.”

As RR04 is not a severe exposure setup, please change this to:

“This matters because false confidence can weaken an otherwise strong security setup over time.”

Please **double-check** these changes have been made before re-sending and I will be able to sign off.

Thanks
